description: This file defines the ValueValidator class used for validating string values against reserved characters in the SuiteCRM JSON API filter validators.

classes.name: ValueValidator
classes.description: Validator class that checks if a string contains any reserved characters and throws an exception if the input is not a string.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the provided value is a string and does not contain any reserved characters; returns true if valid, otherwise false or throws an exception.
